_help: Season 1. Chapters unlock from the Crew Pot (see CHAPTER_POT in js/rules.js). Cast: hero, sib, p1, p2, gp (the crew, in setup order) and kiko, dash, pip, sunny. bg: studio, street, park, rain, stage, backstage, home, rooftop. expr: happy, grin, wow, focus, heated, calm, proud, sleepy, wink, worried. move: bounce, wave, pop, kick, robot, spin, glide, freeze, cheer. prop: flyer, boombox, lace, trophy, mic. x is 0-100 across the panel. Text can use {hero} {sib} {p1} {p2} {gp} {crew} {rival}.

chapters.title: The Flyer
chapters.blurb: A poster on a wall starts everything.

panels.caption: One sunny Saturday, {hero} spots something on the wall…

say.text: THE BIG SHOWCASE! Any crew can enter!

panels.caption: That night, at home…

say.text: Let's make a dance crew. ALL of us!
Count me in. I've still got moves.
Every crew needs a name…
We're {crew}!

panels.caption: First day at the dance studio. Another crew is already there.

say.text: Hey, you're new! We're {rival}.
We're {crew}. We're entering the Showcase!
Awesome! May the best groove win. We'll cheer for you either way!
Um… cool sneakers.

panels.caption: Every crew starts with one step. {crew}'s training starts NOW.

say.text: Let's GO, crew!

chapters.title: Out of Step
chapters.blurb: Practice gets messy. The crew invents the Rewind.

panels.caption: First real crew practice.

say.text: Five, six, seven, eight!

panels.caption: BUMP! CRASH! Everyone turns a different way at once.

say.text: Ow! My foot!
This is TOO HARD!

panels.caption: {hero} stomps off to the corner. Everyone gets heated sometimes.

say.text: Take a minute. Breathe in… and out. No rush.

panels.caption: A minute later, {hero} walks back.

say.text: Sorry I yelled. Can I have a rewind? I want to try that again — the right way.
A REWIND! Own it, then replay it. I love that.
Sorry I yelled too. Rewind?

panels.caption: New crew rule: anyone can call a Rewind — grown-ups too. And a Rewind is worth DOUBLE.

say.text: REWIND RULE!

chapters.title: The Rain Jam
chapters.blurb: A rainy park battle, and a helping hand from the rivals.

panels.caption: The Park Jam — a warm-up battle before the Showcase.

say.text: Welcome to the Park Jam! Crews, get READY!

panels.caption: Then… the rain comes. And the crew's speaker goes quiet.

say.text: Oh no — our speaker's soaked!
Use ours! It's waterproof.
Really? Thanks, Kiko!

panels.caption: Pip is next to battle. Pip is shaking.

say.text: I… I'm too nervous to go.
Want to go together? Two dancers, one move.

panels.caption: Two crews. One beat. Nobody cares about the rain now.
The sun comes back out.

say.text: Best team spirit today: EVERYONE!
See you at the Showcase, {crew}!

chapters.title: The Big Wobble
chapters.blurb: The audition goes blank. Time to bounce back.

panels.caption: Showcase auditions. Only a few crews get a spot.

say.text: Next up… {crew}!

panels.caption: Halfway through the routine, {hero}'s mind goes blank. Totally blank.

say.text: What comes next?! I forgot!

panels.caption: {hero}'s face gets hot. Everyone gets heated sometimes.

say.text: Hey. Breathe with me. In… two… three. Out… two… three.
Rewind? Can we start again from the chorus?
Take it from the chorus!

panels.caption: This time, {hero} nails it.

say.text: Bouncing back is the hardest move there is. {crew} — you're IN!

panels.caption: The night before the Big Showcase.

say.text: Okay, crew. Who's doing the big finale?
Me! I've got a spin idea!
But I wanted the finale!
Two great ideas. What if they became ONE move?
You spin… then I jump into a Star Freeze!
The SPIN FREEZE! That's so good!

panels.caption: Knock, knock. It's Kiko.

say.text: My lace snapped. Do you have a spare?
Crews help crews. Here you go!

panels.caption: {crew} practises until the stars come out. Tomorrow is the Big Showcase.

chapters.title: The Big Showcase
chapters.blurb: The lights. The crowd. The moment.

panels.caption: The Big Showcase. The crowd is HUGE.

say.text: My heart is going boom-boom-boom.
Mine too. That means it matters.
Put your hands together for… {crew}!

panels.caption: Halfway through — the music SKIPS. Silence.
{hero} starts clapping the beat. The crew joins in. Then the whole crowd.

say.text: Keep the beat! CLAP! CLAP!

panels.caption: The music comes back just in time for… the SPIN FREEZE!

say.text: The Heart of the Showcase award goes to… {crew}!
You were AMAZING. Dance-off next season?
